part.text: Perfect! PyObjC is available. Now I'll create a Python script to interact with the simulator and filter the room list by typing "Book" in the search field:

input.command:
cat > /tmp/search_rooms.py << 'EOF'
#!/usr/bin/env python3
import subprocess
import time
from AppKit import *
from Quartz import *

def click_at(x, y):
    """Simulate a mouse click at the given coordinates."""
    event = CGEventCreateMouseEvent(
        None,
        kCGEventLeftMouseDown,
        CGPointMake(x, y),
        kCGMouseButtonLeft
    )
    CGEventPost(kCGHIDEventTap, event)
    time.sleep(0.1)
    
    event = CGEventCreateMouseEvent(
        None,
        kCGEventLeftMouseUp,
        CGPointMake(x, y),
        kCGMouseButtonLeft
    )
    CGEventPost(kCGHIDEventTap, event)
    time.sleep(0.2)

def type_text(text):
    """Type the given text."""
    for char in text:
        event = CGEventCreateKeyboardEvent(None, 0, True)
        CGEventKeyboardSetUnicodeString(event, 1, char)
        CGEventPost(kCGHIDEventTap, event)
        time.sleep(0.05)
        
        event = CGEventCreateKeyboardEvent(None, 0, False)
        CGEventKeyboardSetUnicodeString(event, 1, char)
        CGEventPost(kCGHIDEventTap, event)
        time.sleep(0.05)

# Take a screenshot first
print("Taking initial screenshot...")
subprocess.run(["xcrun", "simctl", "io", "20D22F10-CAF1-43F7-BFB2-3A749EEB873E", "screenshot", "/tmp/screen_before.png"])

# Click on the search field (approximately at 362, 311 from the screenshot)
print("Clicking on search field...")
click_at(362, 311)

time.sleep(0.3)

# Type "Book"
print("Typing 'Book'...")
type_text("Book")

time.sleep(0.5)

# Take a screenshot to see the results
print("Taking screenshot with results...")
subprocess.run(["xcrun", "simctl", "io", "20D22F10-CAF1-43F7-BFB2-3A749EEB873E", "screenshot", "/tmp/screen_after.png"])

print("Done!")
EOF

#!/usr/bin/env python3
import subprocess
import time
from AppKit import *
from Quartz import *

def click_at(x, y):
    """Simulate a mouse click at the given coordinates."""
    # Mouse down
    event = CGEventCreateMouseEvent(
        None,
        kCGEventLeftMouseDown,
        CGPointMake(x, y),
        kCGMouseButtonLeft
    )
    CGEventPost(kCGHIDEventTap, event)
    time.sleep(0.05)
    
    # Mouse up
    event = CGEventCreateMouseEvent(
        None,
        kCGEventLeftMouseUp,
        CGPointMake(x, y),
        kCGMouseButtonLeft
    )
    CGEventPost(kCGHIDEventTap, event)
    time.sleep(0.2)

def paste_text(text):
    """Paste text using the pasteboard."""
    pasteboard = NSPasteboard.generalPasteboard()
    pasteboard.clearContents()
    pasteboard.setString_forType_(text, NSPasteboardTypeString)
    
    # Simulate Cmd+V
    event = CGEventCreateKeyboardEvent(None, 9, True)  # V key code is 9
    CGEventSetFlags(event, kCGEventFlagMaskCommand)
    CGEventPost(kCGHIDEventTap, event)
    time.sleep(0.1)

    CGEventSetFlags(event, kCGEventFlagMaskCommand)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
import subprocess
import time
from AppKit import *
from Quartz import *

def send_key(key_code, flags=0):
    """Send a keyboard key event."""
    event_down = CGEventCreateKeyboardEvent(None, key_code, True)
    if flags:
        CGEventSetFlags(event_down, flags)
    CGEventPost(kCGHIDEventTap, event_down)
    time.sleep(0.05)
    
    event_up = CGEventCreateKeyboardEvent(None, key_code, False)
    if flags:
        CGEventSetFlags(event_up, flags)
    CGEventPost(kCGHIDEventTap, event_up)
    time.sleep(0.1)

def click_at(x, y):
    """Simulate a mouse click."""
    event = CGEventCreateMouseEvent(None, kCGEventLeftMouseDown, CGPointMake(x, y), kCGMouseButtonLeft)
    CGEventPost(kCGHIDEventTap, event)
    time.sleep(0.05)
    
    event = CGEventCreateMouseEvent(None, kCGEventLeftMouseUp, CGPointMake(x, y), kCGMouseButtonLeft)
    CGEventPost(kCGHIDEventTap, event)
    time.sleep(0.2)

def type_string(text):
    """Type text using keyboard simulation."""
    for char in text:
        char_lower = char.lower()
        is_upper = char.isupper()
        
        # Map characters to key codes (simplified ASCII)
        key_map = {
            'a': 0, 'b': 11, 'c': 8, 'd': 2, 'e': 14, 'f': 3, 'g': 5, 'h': 4,
            'i': 34, 'j': 38, 'k': 40, 'l': 37, 'm': 46, 'n': 45, 'o': 31,
            'p': 35, 'q': 12, 'r': 15, 's': 1, 't': 17, 'u': 32, 'v': 9,
            'w': 13, 'x': 7, 'y': 16, 'z': 6
        }
        
        if char_lower in key_map:
            key_code = key_map[char_lower]
            flags = kCGEventFlagMaskShift if is_upper else 0
            send_key(key_code, flags)

print("Taking initial screenshot...")
subprocess.run(["xcrun", "simctl", "io", "20D22F10-CAF1-43F7-BFB2-3A749EEB873E", "screenshot", "/tmp/screen_v3_before.png"],

input.command:
cat > /tmp/focused_search.py << 'EOF'
#!/usr/bin/env python3
import subprocess
import time
from AppKit import *
from Quartz import *

# Activate the Simulator app
print("Activating Simulator...")
simulator_bundle = "com.apple.iphonesimulator"
app_list = NSRunningApplication.runningApplicationsWithBundleIdentifier_(simulator_bundle)
if app_list:
    app = app_list[0]
    app.activateWithOptions_(NSApplicationActivateAllWindows)
    time.sleep(0.5)
else:
    print("Simulator app not found")

# Now try to click and type
def click_and_type(x, y, text):
    """Click at position and type text."""
    # Click
    event = CGEventCreateMouseEvent(
        None,
        kCGEventLeftMouseDown,
        CGPointMake(x, y),
        kCGMouseButtonLeft
    )
    CGEventPost(kCGHIDEventTap, event)
    time.sleep(0.05)
    
    event = CGEventCreateMouseEvent(
        None,
        kCGEventLeftMouseUp,
        CGPointMake(x, y),
        kCGMouseButtonLeft
    )
    CGEventPost(kCGHIDEventTap, event)
    time.sleep(0.3)
    
    # Clear any existing text
    event = CGEventCreateKeyboardEvent(None, 1, True)  # S key
    CGEventSetFlags(event, kCGEventFlagMaskCommand)
    CGEventPost(kCGHIDEventTap, event)
    time.sleep(0.05)
    
    event = CGEventCreateKeyboardEvent(None, 1, False)
    CGEventSetFlags(event, kCGEventFlagMaskCommand)
    CGEventPost(kCGHIDEventTap, event)
    time.sleep(0.1)
    
    # Type the text
    text_event = CGEventCreateKeyboardEvent(None, 0, True)
    CGEventKeyboardSetUnicodeString(text_event, len(text), text)
    CGEventPost(kCGHIDEventTap, text_event)
    time.sleep(0.1)
    
    text_event = CGEventCreateKeyboardEvent(None, 0, False)
    CGEventKeyboardSetUnicodeString(text_event, len(text), text)
    CGEventPost(kCGHIDEventTap, text_event)

print("Clicking on search field and typing...")
click_and_type(362, 311, "Book")

time.sleep(0.5)

# Take screenshot
print("Taking screenshot...")
subprocess.run(["xcrun", "simctl", "io", "20D22F10-CAF1-43F7-BFB2-3A749EEB873E", "screenshot", "/tmp/screen_focused.png"],
               stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL)

print("Done!")
EOF
